Panoramic night view of the north bank of the Yangtze River in Yichang, Hubei, seen from mid-river. A continuous two-kilometre riverside city wall of 1990s-2010s Chinese residential slabs and a few taller apartment towers, warm and cool lit windows, pale beige and grey concrete, flat roofs with small rooftop services, a low dark tree line and faint promenade lamps along the water. Hazy blue-hour atmosphere, light fog between the buildings. No bridge, no pagoda, no tower cranes, no text, no signage, no people, no boats, no moon, no stars, no lens flare. Camera perfectly level, telephoto compression, buildings at a consistent scale across the frame, flat matte photographic detail suitable for a distant skyline plate, muted teal-and-amber night grade, realistic ordinary Chinese riverside city, not a fantasy skyline. The sky occupies the top fifth only and is a clean deep blue-grey.
